Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the wave type as electromagnetic. In this scenario, the force is transmitted through the physical compression and expansion of the bowling balls (a mechanical medium), which constitutes a longitudinal mechanical wave (sound/compression wave), not an electromagnetic wave. While the interatomic forces are electromagnetic in nature, the macroscopic propagation of the disturbance through the line of solid objects is classified as a longitudinal wave in physics education contexts. The Planner jumped to a conclusion based on a microscopic interpretation that contradicts the standard macroscopic classification expected for this problem.
